en.description: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
en.name: Venari

zh.description: Khora 忠诚的库娃。她永远的同伴和守护者。
zh.name: 薇娜丽

en.description: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.
en.name: Venari Prime

zh.description: Khora 的意志，薇娜丽的尖牙利爪。
zh.name: 薇娜丽 Prime

en.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
en.name: Panzer Vulpaphyla

zh.description: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。
zh.name: 铁甲狐帕菲拉

en.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
en.name: Crescent Vulpaphyla

zh.description: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。
zh.name: 月刃狐帕菲拉

en.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
en.name: Medjay Predasite

zh.description: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。
zh.name: 守卫扑猎达赛

en.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
en.name: Pharaoh Predasite

zh.description: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。
zh.name: 法老扑猎达赛

en.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
en.name: Vizier Predasite

zh.description: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。
zh.name: 宰相扑猎达赛

en.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
en.name: Sly Vulpaphyla

zh.description: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。
zh.name: 狡黠狐帕菲拉

en.description: This sly feline is playful yet devious.
en.name: Smeeta Kavat

zh.description: 这只狡猾的猫既好玩又诡诈。
zh.name: 笑面型库娃

en.description: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
en.name: Adarza Kavat

zh.description: 凶猛而致命的库娃因其战斗力而备受推崇，它能增加暴击几率并惩罚那些胆敢攻击它的人。
zh.name: 镜像型库娃

en.description: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
en.name: Vasca Kavat

zh.description: 现在，这些库娃已经摆脱了噬血病毒，它们可以通过输送生命来延长自己的生命值，同时也可以延长主人的生命值。
zh.name: 噬血型库娃

en.description: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
en.name: Sahasa Kubrow

zh.description: 一个可靠的伙伴，为他们的 Tenno 主人找到补给并削弱敌人的力量。
zh.name: 突击型库狛

en.description: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
en.name: Helminth Charger

zh.description: 库狛与感染者的实验性混合体。可使用蛆虫和其他感染者的能力造成伤害并控制战场。
zh.name: Helminth 疾冲者

en.description: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
en.name: Huras Kubrow

zh.description: 一个隐秘的伙伴，以惊人的爆炸力量出其不意地击倒敌人。
zh.name: 匿踪型库狛

en.description: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
en.name: Raksa Kubrow

zh.description: 强大的守护者，专注于通过加强防御和驱赶攻击者来保护其主人。
zh.name: 防护型库狛

en.description: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
en.name: Sunika Kubrow

zh.description: 由奥罗金培育，用于战斗。这头武术野兽的使命是制造混乱，击倒最凶猛的对手。
zh.name: 猎杀型库狛

en.description: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
en.name: Chesa Kubrow

zh.description: 一个聪明的伙伴，经过训练可以从敌人手中夺取武器和战利品。
zh.name: 寻猎型库狛

en.description: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
en.name: Diriga

zh.description: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。
zh.name: 电气浮囊

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
en.name: Carrier

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「弹药储转箱」为预设指令，搬运者是一个前锋守护，并配备一把霰弹枪。
zh.name: 搬运者

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
en.name: Dethcube

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。
zh.name: 死亡魔方

en.description: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
en.name: Nautilus

zh.description: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。
zh.name: 鹦鹉螺

en.description: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
en.name: Djinn

zh.description: 以「重击者」和「致命诱惑」为预设指令，引灵是一个战斗守护，还配备了毒镖武器。
zh.name: 引灵

en.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
en.name: Helios

zh.description: 赫利俄斯拥有独特的「侦查」指令并以「分离」作为武器，这位多功能的守护既是致命的守护者，又是资料库的自动扫描器。扫描功能须在身上携带扫描器，且扫描器有可使用的扫描次数才能触发。
zh.name: 赫利俄斯

en.description: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
en.name: Nautilus Prime

zh.description: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 Prime 来保护他的船员。
zh.name: 鹦鹉螺 Prime

en.description: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
en.name: Carrier Prime

zh.description: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。
zh.name: 搬运者 Prime

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
en.name: Dethcube Prime

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，死亡魔方 Prime 是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为死亡机枪 Prime。
zh.name: 死亡魔方 Prime

en.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
en.name: Helios Prime

zh.description: 这个充满求知欲的守护与分离 Prime 一同防卫着它们的主人。
zh.name: 赫利俄斯 Prime

en.description: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
en.name: Shade Prime

zh.description: 阴影 Prime 专长隐形，它装载了激光点发 Prime。和它一同主宰暗影吧。
zh.name: 阴影 Prime

en.description: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
en.name: Wyrm Prime

zh.description: 保镖与地位的象征，在奥罗金时代中，蛟龙守护 Prime 是高阶Tenno 的最后一道防线。
zh.name: 蛟龙 Prime

en.description: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
en.name: Prisma Shade

zh.description: 虚空中的一种稀有珍宝。怎有如此美丽宝物竟是为潜行锻造？
zh.name: 棱晶 阴影

en.description: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
en.name: Oxylus

zh.description: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。
zh.name: 奥克绪罗斯

en.description: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
en.name: Shade

zh.description: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。
zh.name: 阴影

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
en.name: Taxon

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「分子转化」为预设指令，塔克桑利用护盾恢复来保护主人。它装备了阿塔克斯冰冷光束。
zh.name: 塔克桑

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
en.name: Wyrm

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「群体击散」为预设指令，是强力进攻型的守护，并同时具备激光步枪。
zh.name: 蛟龙
